sections.title: Power
sections.steamNote: In Steam Game Mode, Steam's Quick Access › Performance sets the power limit (TDP) and GPU clock through Handheld Daemon; these are what Desktop Mode uses, and what Steam starts from.

items.title: Custom Fan Curve
items.hint: Allows you to set a custom fan curve and to choose the temperature probe (Edge or Junction). Junction is the peak temperature of the chip: responds faster and prevents throttling. Edge is the temperature of the chip: responds slower and prevents overheating.

sections.title: Controller
sections.steamNote: In Steam Game Mode, Steam Input maps buttons per game on top of the controller set here; HHD's Quick Access button opens Steam's.

items.title: Controller Emulation
items.hint: Emulate different controller types to fuse ROG features.

items.title: Info
items.value:
Simple Xbox controller. 
Universal compatibility.
Extra buttons are shortcuts or Steam Input.

items.title: Extra buttons as
items.hint: Changes the behavior of the extra buttons. Left button is Keyboard, right button is Overlay. Or they can be set for Steam Input.

items.title: Swap ROG and Menu/View
items.hint: Swaps the Armory Crate and Command center buttons with start and select.

items.title: Motion Support
items.hint: Enable gyroscope/accelerometer (IMU) support (.3% background CPU use)

items.title: Motion Hz
items.hint: Sets the sampling frequency for the IMU.

items.title: Deadzones & Vibration
items.hint: Configure joystick and trigger deadzones, vibration intensity.

items.title: Nintendo Mode (A-B Swap)
items.hint: Swaps A with B and X with Y.

items.title: Hibernate
items.hint: Saves your progress and powers off the device.

items.title: Hibernate when device asks and at 5%.
items.hint:
Certain devices wake up to force Windows to hibernate. If Linux does not
they cause issues. Detect and hibernate on thermal events and on 5%
battery.

items.title: Reset Settings
items.hint: Resets all Handheld Daemon settings to their default values.

items.title: Enable TDP Controls
items.hint:
Enables TDP management by the Handheld Daemon. While enabled, Handheld Daemon will set and maintain the TDP limits set on start-up and during other device changes (ac/dc).
If the device crashes, TDP setting will be disabled on next startup.

items.title: Steam Powerbutton Handler
items.hint: Enables the Steam Powerbutton handler (responsible for the wink and powerbutton menu).

items.title: Limit Access to localhost
items.hint: Sets the API target to '127.0.0.1' instead '0.0.0.0'.

items.title: Use Security token
items.hint: Generates a security token in `~/.config/hhd/token` that is required for authentication.

items.title: Brightness
items.hint: Sets the brightness level of a display. Only one display is supported and it is the one that was read.
